findings.summary: First Intel cycle produced an audited-positive mechanism transfer. Scout surveyed SGDR, SkillMigrator/'Beyond Domains', Unbrowse, WebNavigator, AWM, SkillWeaver, PolySkill, NeoCognition plus Steam-like skill infrastructure (skills.sh telemetry-ranked packs; Unbrowse route marketplace with three-tier execution ladder) and discovered 15+ additional actors via citation graphs; selected exactly one candidate: sgdr-state-grounded-dynamic-retrieval (arXiv:2606.04391), targeting Graph's measured weakness (hand-authored goal_sig only; entry-context mismatch). This survey content is durable on the scout branch and in the accepted INTEL_LEDGER mission record.

Clean-room reproduction result (prereg frozen before live collection; reference CC BY-SA repo never fetched/viewed): fused task+current-state-summary retrieval with MMR beat task-only retrieval at hard-slice correct@1 36/74 (.486) vs 25/74 (.338) vs incumbent exact goal_sig 0/74 vs random 19/74; 11–0 paired wins, zero reversals. Downstream conversion with identical execution policy: combined novel actions C=75 vs B=84 vs A=421 at success .90/.86/.78. α=0.4 ≡ α=0.5 everywhere (paper/code discrepancy immaterial here); @3 recall driven by MMR; the @1 gain attributable to the state term. Final accepted status after repair chain (audits rounds 0–2 REVISE, round 3 restoration, PASS run 32800296360, director integration fca0acb): VALIDATED_USEFUL at PROOF OF CONCEPT ceiling.

Auditor's REVISE defects (all later fixed in repair chain per INTEL_LEDGER history): R1 broken frozen-hash chain — 4/10 implementation hashes mismatched (collect.py, convert.py, retriever.py, stimuli.py) with no disclosed bugfix for two of them and single-commit history making pre/post-outcome ordering unverifiable; R2 factual error in report §2 — claimed C-only wins on 'login/pager fragments from shifted pages' are false (all 11 wins are the-internet dynamic-loading menu clusters); R3 stale canonical source URL (plusnli/online-skill-learning, not skill-dynamic-retrieval). Auditor independently reimplemented the evaluation from prereg text alone: 522/522 per-query rows identical.

External-source verification notes worth keeping: arXiv:2606.04391 exists with matching title/authors/headline numbers; reference skill_store.py confirms exact formula α·cos(task,desc)+(1−α)·cos(state_summary,desc), pool max(3k,20), greedy MMR λ=0.7, and code default α=0.4 while the paper says α=0.5. SkillMigrator deferred to WATCH: no public code found, smaller claimed effect (−8–10% actions), higher fidelity risk. Vendor headlines kept OFFICIAL_CLAIM tier (Unbrowse 3.6×, WebNavigator 72.9%).

Auditor's maximum defensible wording (binding limits carried into acceptance): advantage concentrates in ONE site's dynamic-menu cluster; wins over incumbent only when hand-authored signatures are absent (21 vs 39 novel when they exist); nothing beyond PROOF OF CONCEPT (no neural embedder, no LLM summarizer, no cross-site transfer tested by SPIDER or SGDR authors). Auditor's own ablations strengthen attribution: wrong-state summary / summary-only / constant-text fusion all fall back to 24/74. Relevance: GRAPH HIGH / PRODUCT MEDIUM / PHYSICS LOW.

~2h27m wall clock total: scout 11m, reproducer 1h47m (dominated by live collection of 12 fragments × 87 query contexts executability ground truth on 3 sandbox sites), audit 29m including full independent reimplementation. Environment friction logged: no LLM API keys present (summarizer ran deterministic contract-faithful stub), Playwright chromium had to be pip-installed mid-job.

failure_signatures: FROZEN_HASH_CHAIN_BREAK: implementation files edited after prereg attestation without a disclosed pre-outcome bugfix commit; detectable only by sha256 comparison against the prereg's hash table.

REPORT_CLAIM_NOT_MATCHING_RAW_ROWS: prose wins attributed to the wrong site cluster (login/pager vs dynamic-loading) while aggregates were numerically correct — aggregate-level verification alone would not have caught it.
research_opportunities: Accepted ledger already queues follow-ups (description-quality binding constraint on books clusters; cross-site transfer untested; neural embedder/LLM summarizer untested at PoC ceiling). Additional log-only observation for future design: constant-text fusion controls were later found unstable under lexical-hash embedders (sha1 bucket collisions) per accepted ledger item 6 — any future fusion null-control needs a collision-safe embedder or larger dimension.
